name: Factory — Basic B — Collect Runner Result

parameters.content:
CONFIGURE IN N8N UI:
Find Building issues and parse their `Factory run: <id>` comment. GET {{$env.FACTORY_RUNNER_URL}}/runs/<id>.
- running: no change
- question: comment message; Building → Waiting for you
- stuck: comment message; Building → Stuck
- done: comment summary and PR URL; Building → Your QA
Never infer a result from a missing run ID.
